integrity: A complete analytic proof is supplied, and independently constructed exact grounded-Laplacian matrices are checked by the included program. Computational samples are corroboration, not proof of an infinite-family result.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted undirected wheels only, exactly two perfectly pinned leaders, unit independent follower noise; no claim for noisy leaders, arbitrary weights, more leaders, or other graph families. Potential equivalent specialized prior literature remains a risk.
title: The sharp two-leader coherence transition on unweighted wheels
